datasheet_identity.title: MMSZ5221B THRU MMSZ5267B SURFACE MOUNT ZENER DIODES

extraction_notes: The MMSZ5229B row was transcribed from the p. 2 table: VZ min 4.09 V, nominal 4.3 V, max 4.52 V at IZT = 20 mA; ZZT = 22 ohm; IR max = 5 uA at VR = 1 V.
The zener curve points are digitized readings from the labeled 4.3 V MMSZ5229B trace in the p. 3 family plot; no interpolation was added.
The datasheet provides characteristic plots for capacitance and impedance but no single numeric capacitance or reverse-recovery-time value for MMSZ5229B.
Maximum ratings include PD = 500 mW, VF = 0.9 V at IF = 10 mA, Tstg = -55 to +150 degC, and Tj = -55 to +150 degC.
